description:
• About our brand and products: Dotty Dungarees is a children’s clothing brand creating timeless, practical pieces designed for real life. We remember growing up in dungarees, free to explore the great outdoors with not a care in the world. So we are set about re-creating that magic and nostalgia by bringing the perfect dungarees to life. The design of our dungarees is classic but unique. All of our dungarees are designed to grow with your child. Adjustable straps and a generous turn-up ensure they last at least a year. Plus, all dungarees up to 24m have a hidden zip for easy nappy changes. Aside from dungarees, we also design dungaree dresses, dungaree shorts, and tops to match, and we launch new collections every season.


• What makes us different: Our dungarees are designed with practicality for parents and comfort for kids. The adjustable straps and turn-ups, which can be rolled up or down, allow the dungarees to grow with your child and last for over a season. Lined with cotton jersey, making it super comfortable and durable for any adventure. Dotty Dungarees feature classic, must-have colours that fit any children's wardrobes, such as classic and stonewash denims, navy, robin red, soft pink, and more. We also feature signature patchwork designs you can't find anywhere else, such as the Rosebed, Primary Patchwork, Juniper, Blackthorn, Tonal Colourblocks, and more.


• How affiliates can earn: You will earn a 10% commission on referral sales whenever a customer makes a purchase through your affiliate link or by using your dedicated coupon code. The coupon code will be assigned once you have joined our affiliate programme.


• How to promote us: You can promote Dotty Dungarees in a way that feels natural to your audience, from product reviews and styling content to “get ready with me” and day-in-the-life videos. We love seeing unboxings, outfit inspiration, and tagged photos or videos shared on Instagram and Facebook. You can also write blog posts or articles and link back using your unique discount code or affiliate link. If you have your own ideas or creative concepts, we’d love to hear them.


• Other information: Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest.
payout_period: Commissions are approved once orders are confirmed (60 days after order creation to allow for returns and refunds). Commissions for orders confirmed between the 1st–30th of each month are paid between the 15th–20th of the following month.
